_comment: Worked example (the Greenmoth 'Happy Plants = 4 Products' build). Creative fields — character.anchor_prompt (host look), character.keyframe_variants + scenes[].keyframe_prompt + scenes[].motion (setting, poses), scenes[].vo + concept.hook_line (tone), voice.{voice_id,voice_chosen,casting_ab}, music.prompt — come from the recipe's choices (host, setting, tone, narrator_voice, music); never copy them as defaults. Brand fields (concept, brand_palette, scene grounds/accents, product_grid, overlay text, wordmark/url) are the demo brand's (Greenmoth): take them from the new brand's kit and real products. Copy the STRUCTURE to config.json. A flat-vector creator-character walks a countable 4-step routine, one step per beat: large corner numeral + labelled chip + tagline + the step's REAL product photo. Character scenes are Kling i2v off text-stripped clean plates (subtle motion, style-preserving negative); ALL text is an animated Remotion DOM overlay (NEVER baked); slate/grid/CTA scenes get no i2v; the closing grid is a PIL composite of real product webps. eleven_v3 full-sentence VO drives word-by-word burned captions over a VO-forward music bed. Built as a ~50s animated master, then re-cut to 30s FROM the animated master. The demo's runnable scripts are not shipped (see PIPELINE.md).

concept.single_point: Happy houseplants need just 4 products (soil mix, plant food, leaf mist, root tonic) — not twenty.
concept.hook_line: Your plant shelf holds twenty different bottles. Really?
concept.concept_label: plant-care routine (NOT 'fertilizer' — step 3 is a leaf mist)

_palette_comment: brand_palette, every scenes[].overlay.ground/accent and product_grid.ground are the demo brand's hexes (Greenmoth) — brand facts, replace with the new brand's colours; never reuse them.

character.mode: anchor-ref (fresh flat-vector — NOT a chained photoreal ref)
character.anchor_prompt: Flat-vector illustration of a woman, mid 30s, short black bob, deep-brown skin tone, green canvas overalls over a striped tee. Clean 2D flat-vector style (Spotify/Anchor lineage), no gradients, no photoreal shading. Consistent character across every scene.
character.style_reference_note: If the brand already has a photoreal character (e.g. assets/characters/anchor/character-anchor.png), use it ONLY as a written descriptor source, NEVER as a `medias` chained ref (it flattens gens to photoreal).

kling.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, realistic skin, style change, gradient shading, text warp, camera shake
kling._note: Holds flat-vector style at LOW motion only. TEST one scene before batching. v3 takes start_image_url (not image_url) and makes sound unless generate_audio is false.

scenes.keyframe_prompt: Creator at a sunny windowsill crowded with 20+ bottles/sprays/bags from many brands between potted plants; faintly comedic, overwhelmed.
scenes.vo: Your plant shelf holds twenty different bottles.

scenes.motion: small natural smile + shrug; clutter settles
scenes.keyframe_prompt: Same creator, small smile + shrug at the crowded windowsill.

scenes.vo: Happy plants only need four products.

scenes.motion: tips a scoop of chunky soil mix into a terracotta pot; minimal drift
scenes.keyframe_prompt: Creator tips a scoop of chunky soil mix into a terracotta pot; teal accent panel.

overlay.tagline: Airy potting mix that lets the roots breathe.

scenes.vo: One — a chunky soil mix. Repot once and the roots can finally breathe.

scenes.motion: tips a capful of plant food into a watering can
scenes.keyframe_prompt: Creator tips a capful of plant food into a watering can; sand accent panel.

overlay.tagline: A gentle liquid feed for steady new leaves every single month.

scenes.vo: Two — a gentle liquid plant food for steady new leaves every single month.

scenes.motion: gives a monstera leaf two soft mist sprays
scenes.keyframe_prompt: Creator mists a monstera leaf; pale-sage accent panel.

overlay.tagline: A fine leaf mist — dusty leaves look fresh in seconds.

scenes.vo: Three — a leaf mist, and dusty leaves look fresh in seconds.

scenes.motion: pours from a watering can into a pot, soft light rays
scenes.keyframe_prompt: Creator waters a pot with a watering can, soft light rays; leaf-green accent panel.

overlay.tagline: A monthly root tonic that keeps every single pot thriving.

scenes.vo: Four — a root tonic in the watering can that keeps every single pot thriving.

scenes.motion: satisfied smile, holding 1 bottle; tidy windowsill (callback to scene 1)
scenes.keyframe_prompt: Creator at the windowsill, satisfied smile, holding one bottle; tidy, thriving plants.
scenes.vo: Ditch the twenty-bottle shelf. Keep the four that work.
Greenmoth. Plant care, made simple. Greenmoth dot example.

product_grid.method: PIL composite of the 4 REAL product webps (never AI — AI duplicates SKUs)

voice._note: Write VO as FULL SENTENCES (not keyword fragments). with-timestamps char-level timings drive the word-by-word captions.

music.prompt: Lo-fi pop bed, 95-105 BPM, builds across sections (intro pad -> groove -> warm -> lo-fi build -> resolved). NOT cinematic, NOT moody. No melody hooks competing with VO. Instrumental only.
music.mix_profile: VO-forward: vo loudnorm I=-15, music loudnorm I=-25 + volume 0.5, sidechaincompress duck, final alimiter limit=0.89, target ~-15 LUFS / -1 dBTP

captions.method: word-by-word burned from eleven_v3 with-timestamps (libass; Klap is the hosted equivalent)
captions._suppress_note: slate/grid/CTA scenes carry their own on-screen text — two text layers collide.

cutdowns.source: working/silent-master.mp4 (the ANIMATED master — NEVER a static intermediate)
cutdowns.rules: trim short beats (never freeze); gently slow long beats (setpts, clamp <=1.6x); re-burn scaled captions (timestamps / vo_speedup, offset to new scene starts); suppress on 3/8/10

variants.v1: full 10-beat story, VO @1.25x (atempo), silences trimmed, ~30s — THE MAIN DELIVERABLE
variants.v2: hook-led montage: hook -> slate -> grid pulled forward -> rapid 4-product montage (number + product only) -> CTA, ~30s (>=4 cuts/10s)

music.note: music bed under the VO in the style from choices.music (demo: lo-fi pop); off if the user chose no music

end_card.note: CTA + brand wordmark scene, default on
